title: Reading Drill — Planning a safer route from a nursery — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Planning a safer route from a nursery — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Bramley began with reports of parents with prams sharing a narrow doorway with deliveries. The nursery manager had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using caretaker logs and chose obstructions at opening time as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a separate delivery period. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted three weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded late food orders as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
